title: Deterministic capability discovery and transactional skill registration
summary: Coordinated human/machine catalogs, freshness validation and rollback-safe registration make available engineering capabilities inspectable.

dates.note: Exact start/end dates are not documented. Technical mechanisms are reported in the October 5, 2026 snapshot; any later owner clarifications are cited per fact.

facts.text: Implemented deterministic capability discovery with coordinated Markdown/JSON catalogs describing scope, authority, status, triggers, prerequisites and invocation rules.
Built SHA-256 freshness checks over source paths, permission bits and contents, with checks that generated human-readable and machine-readable catalogs agree.
Implemented skill registration with preflight checks, dry runs, refusal to replace unrelated paths, and rollback of newly created links after partial failures.
The supplied snapshot records 18 bootstrap test definitions, including stale-catalog rejection, rollback and secret-free status reporting; these were not executed by that analysis.
